segments.name: Henglong
products: rack and pinion power steering gears
segments.description: Makes rack and pinion power steering gears for cars and light-duty vehicles sold to Chinese automakers.
segments.evidence: Henglong was established in 1997 and mainly engages in the production of rack and pinion power steering gears for cars and light-duty vehicles.

segments.name: Jiulong
segments.description: Produces integral power steering gears for heavy-duty vehicles for truck and commercial vehicle manufacturers.
segments.evidence: Jiulong was established in 1993 and mainly engages in the production of integral power steering gears for heavy-duty vehicles.

segments.name: Wuhu
segments.description: Produces and sells automobile steering systems to vehicle manufacturers in China.
segments.evidence: Wuhu was established in 2006 and mainly engages in the production and sales of automobile steering systems.

segments.name: Hubei Henglong
segments.description: Produces and sells automotive steering systems through its subsidiaries and joint ventures for vehicle makers.
segments.evidence: On March 7, 2007, Genesis established Hubei Henglong, formerly known as Jingzhou Hengsheng Automotive System Co., Ltd., its wholly-owned subsidiary, to engage in the production and sales of automotive steering systems.

segments.name: Henglong KYB
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells automobile electronic steering systems, including after-sales service, for vehicle makers.
segments.evidence: established Hubei Henglong KYB Automobile Electric Steering System Co., Ltd., "Henglong KYB", which mainly engages in design, manufacture, sales and after-sales service of automobile electronic systems.

segments.name: Brazil Henglong
segments.description: Imports and sells automotive parts in Brazil to local customers.
segments.evidence: Brazil Henglong engages mainly in the import and sales of automotive parts in Brazil.

segments.description: Groups the remaining smaller subsidiaries and joint ventures reported beside the named product sectors.
